== Summary ==
Slip “It Is The Future You See” cut unchanged from page 9 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 839, 1624, 1229)). Version [[It Is The Future You See (V)#Source formats|It Is The Future You See (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
